categories.team: Advertising Sales - Emerging and Scaled Sales

descriptionPlain: Sell what you love. For us and millions of users across the globe, that’s Spotify. Join the Sales team and you’ll build the relationships that help grow our business in existing markets and beyond. We don’t just sell creative solutions to our clients and partners, we help to shape them; using our expert knowledge of ad products, sales channels and the industry to impact the way the world experiences music and podcasts.
description:
Sell what you love. For us and millions of users across the globe, that’s Spotify. Join the Sales team and you’ll build the relationships that help grow our business in existing markets and beyond. We don’t just sell creative solutions to our clients and partners, we help to shape them; using our expert knowledge of ad products, sales channels and the industry to impact the way the world experiences music and podcasts. 

We're looking for a Client Partner to join our Emerging & Scaled Sales team, one of the fastest-growing teams within Spotify Advertising. In this role, you'll own and grow a portfolio of strategic clients, serving as a trusted advisor who understands their business goals and delivers advertising solutions that drive measurable impact. You'll combine strategic thinking, commercial expertise, and relationship management to develop long-term partnerships while helping advertisers unlock the full value of Spotify's advertising platform.
 
If you're passionate about digital advertising, thrive in a consultative sales environment, and enjoy building lasting client relationships, we'd love to hear from you.

lists.content:
• Build and grow strategic relationships with advertisers by understanding their business objectives and delivering consultative, insight-driven recommendations.
  • Own a portfolio of clients and develop account strategies that drive long-term growth, retention, and revenue expansion.
  • Identify, develop, and close new business opportunities while expanding existing partnerships across your assigned market and vertical.
  • Create compelling sales narratives by leveraging market insights, campaign learnings, audience intelligence, and Spotify's advertising solutions.
  • Meet and exceed advertising revenue goals by developing strategic account plans and proactively identifying opportunities to grow your business.
  • Analyze campaign performance and client data to develop actionable insights and optimization recommendations that improve business outcomes.
  • Develop deep expertise in Spotify's advertising products, platform capabilities, and industry trends to position innovative solutions that align with client objectives.
  • Manage an active sales pipeline, maintain accurate forecasting, and effectively prioritize opportunities across multiple accounts.
  • Partner closely with cross-functional teams—including Sales Planning, Client Services, Marketing, Product, Measurement, and Data—to deliver exceptional client experiences and maximize campaign success.
  • Contribute to the ongoing evolution of Spotify Advertising by sharing market insights, client feedback, and best practices across the broader sales organization.

• You have 5+ years of experience managing client relationships and driving revenue within a digital advertising, media, or advertising technology organization. Experience in audio advertising is a plus.
  • You know how to build executive-level relationships and act as a trusted advisor by delivering thoughtful, consultative solutions.
  • You have a proven track record of meeting or exceeding revenue targets while managing a complex portfolio of clients.
  • You are experienced in developing strategic account plans and identifying opportunities to grow existing business while generating new revenue.
  • You are highly organized and comfortable managing multiple priorities in a fast-paced, evolving environment.
  • You communicate clearly and confidently, adapting your approach to influence a variety of internal and external stakeholders.
  • You enjoy collaborating across cross-functional teams and believe strong partnerships create the best outcomes for clients.
  • You care about delivering an outstanding customer experience and using data and insights to inform recommendations and drive results.
  • You approach your work with integrity, curiosity, accountability, and a growth mindset, and you're excited to help shape the future of Spotify Advertising.
  • English and Portuguese fluency, spoken and written is required.
  • Please apply with a CV in English.

• This role is based in São Paulo.
  • We offer you the flexibility to work where you work best! There will be some in person meetings, but still allows for flexibility to work from home.
  • We ask that you come in 2-3 times per week.

descriptionPlain: The Ringer is looking for an experienced Talent Relations Manager to work with high-profile talent and book guests across our slate of shows. You’ll partner closely with our content teams, hosts, and producers to identify compelling talent opportunities and strategically book guests who connect with each show’s audience. You’ll bring strong relationships across the entertainment industry, sound judgment, and a genuine passion for podcasts and culture.
description: The Ringer is looking for an experienced Talent Relations Manager to work with high-profile talent and book guests across our slate of shows. You’ll partner closely with our content teams, hosts, and producers to identify compelling talent opportunities and strategically book guests who connect with each show’s audience. You’ll bring strong relationships across the entertainment industry, sound judgment, and a genuine passion for podcasts and culture.

lists.content:
• Manage talent bookings across The Ringer’s podcast network, partnering closely with hosts and producers to identify and secure compelling guests.
  • Build consistent workflows and communication with show teams, including regular check-ins, guest pitches, and planning around tentpole events and key coverage moments.
  • Develop thoughtful guest strategies that align talent opportunities with each show’s audience, voice, and editorial priorities.
  • Support hosts and producers in preparing for guest appearances and help ensure teams have the information and resources they need.
  • Build trusted relationships with hosts across the network and act as a bridge between show teams and senior leadership.
  • Develop and maintain strong external relationships with talent, managers, agents, publicists, PR firms, studios, and networks.
  • Keep internal and external partners informed about new shows, launches, and opportunities across The Ringer network.

• You have 5+ years of relevant experience working with celebrities, creators, managers, publicists, or other partners across the entertainment industry.
  • You have a demonstrated track record of booking high-profile guests and building trusted relationships with talent and their representatives.
  • You are a persuasive and thoughtful communicator who knows how to develop and pitch opportunities to internal and external partners.
  • You use audience insights, performance data, and strong editorial judgment to inform talent and booking decisions.
  • You have experience booking talent for podcasts, digital content, television, film, or related entertainment formats.
  • You have a strong understanding of pop culture and stay curious about emerging talent, conversations, and cultural moments.
  • You bring professionalism, discretion, sound judgment, and strong organizational skills to sensitive and fast-moving situations.
  • You are comfortable adapting to changing talent needs and traveling when the role requires it.

• This role is based in Los Angeles, California.
  • We offer you the flexibility to work where you work best! There will be some in person meetings, but still allows for flexibility to work from home. We ask that you come in 3-4 days a week.

descriptionPlain:
The Audiobooks Mission is a team in the Product & Technology organisation focused on the ecosystem and strategies of Audiobooks on Spotify. We work across both the creator and consumer audiobooks ecosystems, in order to get the best possible product to market with the best possible content.
Spotify's Audiobooks team is helping shape the future of audio storytelling by bringing the world's best audiobook experiences to millions of listeners. As Associate Manager, Audiobook Licensing & Author Partnerships, you'll play an important role in growing our catalog while building meaningful relationships across the independent publishing community.
You'll work with entrepreneurial authors, hybrid publishers, independent presses, and distribution partners to identify great content, negotiate commercial partnerships, and help creators succeed on Spotify. Working closely with cross-functional teams across Product, Editorial, Growth, Operations, and Finance, you'll help scale our audiobook business while creating exceptional experiences for both creators and listeners.

Spotify's Audiobooks team is helping shape the future of audio storytelling by bringing the world's best audiobook experiences to millions of listeners. As Associate Manager, Audiobook Licensing & Author Partnerships, you'll play an important role in growing our catalog while building meaningful relationships across the independent publishing community.

You'll work with entrepreneurial authors, hybrid publishers, independent presses, and distribution partners to identify great content, negotiate commercial partnerships, and help creators succeed on Spotify. Working closely with cross-functional teams across Product, Editorial, Growth, Operations, and Finance, you'll help scale our audiobook business while creating exceptional experiences for both creators and listeners.

lists.content:
• Identify and evaluate audiobook catalogs from independent authors, hybrid publishers, independent presses, and distribution partners that will resonate with Spotify listeners.
  • Negotiate audiobook licensing agreements and commercial partnerships that create long-term value for Spotify and our publishing partners.
  • Build trusted relationships across a diverse portfolio of independent publishers, distributors, and authors, serving as their primary strategic contact.
  • Develop creative partnership structures that support sustainable growth while meeting the evolving needs of creators and publishing businesses.
  • Use market insights, performance analytics, and commercial data to inform acquisition strategies and identify new partnership opportunities.
  • Partner with creators and publishers to optimize catalog performance, improve discoverability, and resolve operational challenges.
  • Collaborate closely with Product, Editorial, Growth, Operations, Finance, and other cross-functional teams to improve partner experience and support Spotify's audiobook strategy.
  • Advocate internally for the needs of independent creators and publishers, helping shape future product capabilities and strategic initiatives.
  • Contribute to initiatives focused on catalog expansion, subscriber value, listening growth, operational excellence, and blended cost per content hour (CPCH) optimization.

• You have 3+ years of experience in publishing, digital media, business development, content licensing, content partnerships, or a related field.
  • You have experience negotiating and closing commercial licensing, distribution, or partnership agreements.
  • You have a strong understanding of the independent publishing ecosystem, including indie authors, hybrid publishers, audiobook distributors, and digital publishing models.
  • You understand the unique opportunities and challenges facing entrepreneurial creators and independent publishing businesses.
  • You build trusted relationships and effectively influence a broad range of internal and external stakeholders.
  • You use data, financial insights, and market trends to inform commercial decisions and partnership strategies.
  • You manage multiple priorities effectively while maintaining strong attention to detail in a fast-paced environment.
  • You are comfortable navigating ambiguity, taking ownership, and finding practical solutions to complex business challenges.
  • You care about helping creators succeed and are passionate about audiobooks, storytelling, and the evolving creator economy.
  • You hold a Bachelor's degree; an MBA or other advanced degree is beneficial.
  • You are comfortable collaborating across multiple time zones and are willing to travel when needed.
• We offer you the flexibility to work where you work best! For this role, you can be within the North Americas region as long as we have a work location.
